lore.short: Elf King who rules the Moon Elves.

skills.name: Scripture of the Moon Elf
skills.description: Scripture of the Moon Elf slowly charges energy for Estes. Upon reaching 100 stacks, it enhances his next Basic Attack, dealing 250 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target. The attack will ricochet to nearby enemies, dealing 125 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 60% for 1.5s.

skills.name: Moonlight Immersion
skills.description:
Estes recovers 200 (+110% Total Magic Power) HP for the target allied hero immediately and links himself with them for 5s.
While linked, both heroes gain 15 (+10% Total Magic Power) , and the target slowly recovers 360 (+90% Total Magic Power) HP. Linking with an allied hero increases Estes' Movement Speed by 15%, as well as the energy charging speed of the Scripture of the Moon Elf.
Being too far from the target will break the link.

skills.name: Domain of Moon Goddess
skills.description: Estes drops a flood of moonlight on the target area, dealing 350 (+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemy units within it. Afterwards, it turns to a domain of the Moon Goddess and reveals enemies inside it. Enemies will be slowed by 90% for 1.5s if they touch the edge of the domain area. (The slow effect will decay over time.)

skills.name: Blessing of Moon Goddess
skills.description:
Estes casts an enhanced Moonlight Immersion on himself and all nearby allied heroes, refreshing Moonlight Immersion on them and enhancing it for 8s.
Enhanced Moonlight Immersion: Doubles the Instant Basic Healing and  Increase, and heals the target for 1020 (+225% Total Magic Power) HP over time.

assist.desc: Estes works best with typical Marksman heroes, his healing will allow them to deal more damage. Heroes like Lesley and Hanabi are good examples here.

strong.desc: Estes counters heroes with no burst damage, he can easily heal through minor damages from heroes like Faramis and Alice.

weak.desc: Estes is countered by heroes with high burst damage. Heroes like Saber and Eudora can easily burst down Estes or the hero he protects in a few seconds.
